Variants.Content: Volga–Don herds, pasture and exchange sustain camps, with grain and iron still obtained from settlers and merchants. More followers also mean more grazing and water demand.

Volga–Don herds and exchange sustain Hunnic camps. Traveling followers need real food from this production; valuables still require a buyer and exchange. More followers also require more water and grazing.
